soul_corrections.current_text: Their look is undocumented, so designs, like the toothbrush prop, are [BBG News invention].
soul_corrections.correction: Their looks are documented [Observed] in 2012-2015 gear-up screenshots and renders on the fan wiki. Electric Honey and Blood Spurt also appear in the official 2026 Steam trailer and screenshot [Observed]. Defaults: the Beebeegun is a long charcoal boxy minigun with amber glowing slats and a gold faceted hive on top, held low at the hip. The Hivey League is a grey boxy shotgun with a gold hive and a honeycomb-hole muzzle. The Barbed Gloves are huge mustard-yellow plush creature-mitts wrapped in black barbed wire. Only the toothbrush prop is [BBG News invention]. See the Riggs weapons dossier.

What overhead icon does Freeze Blast give (the yellow-Z 'Slowed' icon?), and what do its floor pools look like?
What is the Buzz Kill explosion's colour and shape, and does the projectile visibly blink or buzz before it detonates?

Is the near-white flash after the Blood Spurt punch (trailer 36.8 s) an impact effect or an edit transition?
